# gitmoap_repository_profile (Data Source)

Get a repository's profile. What a repository carries — a README, a licence and which one, a changelog, a contributing guide, a code of conduct, a security policy, code owners, a service catalog — and how it is set up: its pipelines, whether its default branch is protected, its wiki and its latest release. One read for a project's overview, and for what to suggest adding next.

The token needs `repo:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `ref` (String) Branch, tag, or commit SHA the files are read at. Default: HEAD

### Read-Only

- `commit_sha` (String)
- `files` (Attributes) The files a well-kept repository carries, each present or absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `setup` (Attributes) How the repository is set up beyond its files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--setup))
